network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs through bubblewrap --unshare-net with fixed locale, timezone, and umask. Host-side hash, manifest, and Git checks make no network request. This remains nonrelease evidence because it reuses the canonical warm dependency cache.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact nine-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED status summary retained in validation-receipt.json

scope_boundary: Network-isolated node-scoped replay of the exact statement, conditional root composition, partial proof declarations, and same-worker differential partial reconstructions. It does not cover a proof of the exact root, cold empty-cache hermetic reproduction, complete transitive trust/provenance, or distinct-runner independent verification.
